:::{#def-matrix-column}
#### Column of a matrix

The $j$th **column** of an $m \times n$ [matrix](#def-matrix) $\matr{A}$
is the [column vector](#def-column-vector) of the entries in column $j$:

$$
\matr{A}_{:,j} =
\begin{bmatrix} a_{1j} \\ a_{2j} \\ \vdots \\ a_{mj} \end{bmatrix}.
$$

Placing the $n$ columns side by side gives back the matrix,
so $\matr{A}$ is a row of column vectors:

$$
\matr{A} =
\begin{bmatrix}
\matr{A}_{:,1} & \cdots & \matr{A}_{:,n}
\end{bmatrix}.
$$

:::
